text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. Okay, here's to the success of our
boot camp and the Heartfire
Ceremony.

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man, a kickoff party—now that was a
stroke of genius. Nothin' like a
good ol'
get together to build some team spirit!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You know it! What Ardan said gave me an
idea. If you really wanna come together as
a team, you gotta get around a table and
let the
drinks flow!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Right then, I better do my job as the
organizer. Let's get this Team
Spirit
Takoyaki-and-Sometimes-Meat Party
goin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Orarararara! Let's gooooo! Hryahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Look at those hands! Truly fast as
lightning! Takoyaki are
materializing in the
blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You haven't seen nothin' yet! I'm gonna
needa pick up the pace with
the
gluttonous Beast of Tracen here!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama's takoyaki... My stomach's getting
impatient.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I have some meat on the grill over
here, so you can have some
to whet your
appetite if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And after the meat, it's yakisoba time!
Hope you're ready, 'cause
you're 'bout to
see a food stall pro in action!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! It's starting to feel like a
festival!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone dig in! Oh, except
Oguri—just nibbles for now!
Leave some
for the others!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I-I'll try!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wazzup, you Oguri's mom or somethin'?
No eatin' too much, no taste
testin' before
it's done?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Who da hell ya callin' "mom"?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Eating at one big table with everyone sure
gets... rowdy. But equally
fun and exciting,
too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it was a nice change of pace.
Tamamo, thank you for
proposing the
idea.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't mention it! I just blurted out
what I thought sounded fun,
and you all
humored me, so I'm the one who should be
sayin' thanks.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ever since this ceremony business got
dropped on us, you've constantly been
takin' the lead.
Care to let us in on what's got ya so
fired up?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Where's this comin' from? ...It's nothin'
dramatic like you're
thinkin'—just some
personal stuff.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
They say good luck comes to whoever
bears the Heartfire, don't
they? Well, I
figured I'd get what luck I can for my
upcomin' races.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
'Cause from now on, I plan on doin' a
whole lotta winnin'. I wanna win
and win
and win... and grab my dreams by the tail!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And to do that,
just trainin' like hell's not
gonna cut it. Luck, fate,
what have ya—I
gotta have it all on my side.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I wanna be a Heartfire
Bearer. If this opportunity will
get me even
an inch closer to those victories...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm gonna pounce on it. Every single
chance that presents itself
to me, I'll seize
'em all... And then, I'm gonna win. That's
all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Pure, unadultered ambition. I
understand, now, where that strong
will of
yours draws its source from.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, no bein' overdramatic! All right,
enough about me. Let's clean up
and get
ready for tonight's group practice!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Not so fast,
now! You can't drop that on us
then call it just like that.
We gotta gather
'round and end this the proper way, don't
we?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Round? Well, my stomach's gotten pretty
round...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That's not what I'm talkin' about,
Oguri. We gotta gather
'round, solidify our
team spirit! In a circle! Y'know,
a huddle!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I getcha, I getcha. Fine by me! All
right, everyone gather
round!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna make this Heartfire
Ceremony a success! Ready?

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Hip, hip, hooray!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their days of practice fly by...

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Oguri & Ardan
text_block_list.text: HAHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's it,
you two! Just like that—go wild!

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text:
From past to present, present to future,
those who run a path known to none, we
pray they find fortune at its end and, in
this moment,
invoke their myriad emotions.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I did it!
I got through it without tripping
up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Booyah! This midterm rehearsal is gonna
be a piece of cake! Ms.
Mukai won't know
what hit her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, the day of the midterm
rehearsal arrives.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
That concludes your midterm rehearsal.
Now then, I'd like to offer my
current
thoughts on your performance.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
First off, I commend you for coming so far
in so short a time. You left
no doubt in my
mind as to how seriously you're taking
this.

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
Your performance has certainly reached
the level expected of you at this midway
point. Which makes it all the more
important that I make
one thing clear...

text_block_list.name: Ms. Mukai
text_block_list.text:
If nothing changes, I'm afraid I won't be
able to let you perform the
ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wha?!
